Purchase or gift one subscription during a Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 stream to earn the Modern Warfare 4 chat badge!

How to get these drops

  1. Link your Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 account to Twitch — Connect your account ↗, or via Twitch Settings → Connections. One-time setup.
  2. Watch an eligible stream — Watch any Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 stream on Twitch ↗ that shows the Drops Enabled tag. Progress fills automatically while you watch. Make sure you're logged into Twitch.
  3. Claim your drop — When the progress bar fills, a notification appears in chat. Click it, or go to twitch.tv/drops/inventory ↗ to claim. You have ~24 hours before it expires.
  4. Receive in-game — Rewards appear in your Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 account within a few minutes. Restart the game if they don't show up.

Frequently Asked Questions

What Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Twitch Drops are available?

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has 1 Twitch Drop reward: Modern Warfare 4 Badge. Active campaigns end November 13, 2026.

How do I get Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Twitch Drops?

To earn Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Twitch Drops: link your Twitch account to your Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 game account, watch an eligible stream for the required time, then claim your drops at twitch.tv/drops/inventory. Drops expire if unclaimed after the campaign ends.

When do the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Twitch Drop campaigns end?

The current Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Twitch Drop campaigns end on November 13, 2026. Watch and claim before then — unclaimed drops expire with the campaign.

Which channels should I watch for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Twitch Drops?

Watch any Twitch channel streaming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 while the campaign is active.
